name: LaunchBoom
headline: The pre-launch platform behind $200M+ in crowdfunding presales
overview: LaunchBoom is a crowdfunding marketing agency and a Kickstarter Premier Partner. Techlio built and runs LaunchKit, the pre-launch platform included in every LaunchBoom program: page builder, reservation funnels, analytics, A/B testing, integrations and AI copywriting, along with the marketing site.

challenges.title: Manual, agency-built funnels
challenges.text: Landing pages, reservation checkout and email flows were assembled by hand across separate tools for every campaign.

challenges.title: No single view of performance
challenges.text: Reservations, cost per lead and traffic sources lived in different dashboards.

challenges.title: Creator-owned payments and data
challenges.text: Creators needed funnels on their own domains with payments and emails going to their own accounts.

challenges.title: Scaling ads and copy
challenges.text: Writing page and ad copy for hundreds of campaigns a year took significant strategist time.

solutions.title: Page and funnel builder
solutions.text: A drag-and-drop builder for reservation pages and checkouts on each creator's own domain, live without code.

solutions.title: Analytics and A/B testing
solutions.text: A dashboard tracking reservations, cost per lead and revenue predictions, with real-time page variant testing.

solutions.title: Direct-to-creator integrations
solutions.text: Connections to creators' own payment processors, email platforms and Meta ad accounts.

solutions.title: AI copywriting
solutions.text: Page and ad copy generated in multiple styles within minutes.

results: $200M+ in presales powered by the platform
10K+ pre-launch pages built on the page builder
Included in every LaunchBoom program across products, games and lodging
architecture: The core application is Laravel and React on MySQL, hosted on DigitalOcean and deployed with Laravel Forge, with Node.js services for integrations. Python analytics services use Apache Airflow and dbt to load data into Snowflake, PyTorch and Scikit-learn for modelling, vector search on Pinecone and Qdrant, and n8n for operational automations.
